data.gender_notes: Isar is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic word "asara", meaning ten, and symbolizing help, aid, support and care. It can also mean the helper or supporter. The name Isar carries the meaning “Help, aid, support” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Isar usually hope their child will grow to embody help, aid, support and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Isar belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Help, aid, support.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Isar total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
